questions.question: In processor memory consistency models, which of the following memory access reorderings is permissible under Total Store Order (TSO), as implemented in architectures like x86?
options: A later Load can be reordered ahead of an earlier Store to a different memory address (Store-Load reordering).
A later Store can be reordered ahead of an earlier Store to a different memory address (Store-Store reordering).
A later Load can be reordered ahead of an earlier Load to a different memory address (Load-Load reordering).
A later Store can be reordered ahead of an earlier Load to a different memory address (Load-Store reordering).
A later Store can be reordered ahead of an earlier Store to the same memory address.

questions.question: In combinational digital logic design, what is the fundamental physical cause of a logic "hazard" (glitch) at the output of a gate network?
options: Clock jitter causing sequential storage elements to trigger prematurely.
Unequal propagation delays along converging signal paths that undergo opposite transitions.
Subthreshold leakage current charging the internal node capacitances above the logic threshold.
Excessive capacitive fan-out degrading the rise and fall transition times beyond standard tolerances.
Supply voltage droop causing temporary threshold shifts in the pull-up network.

questions.question: In computer architecture, what fundamentally distinguishes a Very Long Instruction Word (VLIW) processor from a dynamically scheduled superscalar processor?
options: VLIW processors implement hardware register renaming and reorder buffers to dynamically resolve data hazards at runtime.
VLIW processors rely on speculative out-of-order execution units coupled with dynamic branch target buffers.
VLIW processors rely on the compiler to detect parallelism and statically bundle independent operations, eliminating dynamic dependency-checking hardware.
VLIW processors interleave threads cycle-by-cycle to hide long memory latency operations without compiler intervention.
VLIW processors exclusively employ variable-length CISC instructions to maximize code density in the instruction cache.

questions.question: In the ASIC physical design implementation flow, what is the primary objective of Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS)?
options: To swap standard logic cells along critical paths with ultra-low threshold voltage (ULVT) variants.
To synthesize and optimize the RTL behavioral code into primitive logic gates and sequential flip-flops.
To define power rings, power stripes, and macro placement across the core chip boundary.
To construct a balanced clock distribution network that minimizes clock skew and insertion delay across all sequential elements.
To insert scan flip-flops and test compression logic for post-silicon manufacturing fault detection.

questions.question: In dynamic CMOS logic circuits (such as Domino logic), what is the primary role of a weak PMOS "keeper" transistor connected to the dynamic evaluation node?
options: To drive high-current output loads during off-chip signaling transitions.
To clamp the dynamic node to ground during the precharge phase to prevent voltage overshoot.
To speed up the evaluation phase by providing an additional pull-down discharge path.
To eliminate the need for a static CMOS inverter before cascading into subsequent dynamic stages.
To prevent the dynamic node from floating and discharging unintentionally due to subthreshold leakage and charge sharing during evaluation.
